details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Fresh scorch marks surround a pile of shiny scrap.

**Purpose:** Build a hoard and prove ownership of a hunting ground.

**Tactics and retreat:** Breathe along a close approach, then bite while its breath recovers.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Spread out, use stone cover, and negotiate over a specific object it wants.

**Habitat:** Rocky hill; ruined tower · **Communication:** Understands Draconic; speaks short phrases

**Loot:** One shared hoard of 60 coins and ordinary trade goods.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-young-ember-drake


**Category:** Dragon · **Role:** Flying artillery · **CV:** 29

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hot jaws | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. |
| Ember breath | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 fire damage. | 5 fire damage. Burning 1. | 7 fire damage. Burning 2. |
| Claw rake | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage; Bleeding 1. | 6 physical damage; Bleeding 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.65

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.55 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.1, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=4.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [breath](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/breath.md), [Stoke the Core](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/stoke-the-core.md), [Wing Step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/wing-step.md).

[Roster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/roster.md) · [Agreed Stability](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/rules/stability.md)
